description:
Elon Musk wants humans to move to Mars. 

But we, Elon Mars, are here to tell you the stories of the rovers left behind on Mars — abandoned, but never forgotten.
summary:
Cosmic Journey is an interactive educational website that explores the stories of rovers, landers, helicopters, satellites, and telescopes. It includes fifteen mission websites featuring spacecraft such as Opportunity, Spirit, Ingenuity, Kepler, Pioneer, and the Apollo lunar modules.

Users begin with an animated solar system, select destinations, and discover spacecraft. Mars and Moon surface scenes provide clickable mission choices. Each mission combines storytelling, interactive spacecraft models, scientific activities, quizzes, and collectible explorer cards. Music and smooth transitions make the experience engaging, while consistent navigation supports easy exploration.

The project addresses the challenge of making complex space science accessible and interesting, especially for younger learners. Rather than relying on lengthy explanations, it encourages learning through exploration, interaction, and discovery.

Cosmic Journey promotes curiosity, independent learning, and appreciation of science and engineering. By showing how spacecraft overcome challenges and uncover evidence, it highlights the creativity, teamwork, and persistence behind space exploration. It connects individual missions into a wider story of humanity’s journey beyond Earth.
details:
Cosmic Journey is an interactive educational website that helps users discover space exploration through fifteen mission websites. It features rovers, landers, a helicopter, satellites, telescopes, and lunar spacecraft.

How it works

Users begin with an animated solar system and choose a destination. They can select spacecraft orbiting planets or explore clickable Mars and Moon surface scenes. Each mission presents a story through illustrations, interactive spacecraft models, scientific activities, and quizzes. Users can rotate models and select components to learn their functions. At the end, they choose a favourite discovery and receive a downloadable explorer card.

Benefits and intended impact

The project makes space science more approachable, especially for younger learners. Short explanations and interactive activities help users explore unfamiliar concepts at their own pace. Quizzes reinforce learning, while mission stories highlight the creativity, teamwork, and persistence behind scientific discovery. The intended impact is to encourage curiosity and interest in science, technology, and engineering.

Tools and development

The website was developed using HTML for structure, CSS for styling and responsive layouts, and JavaScript for navigation, animations, quizzes, and activities. Three.js supports interactive 3D spacecraft models, while SVG and Canvas provide illustrations and visual effects. NASA mission resources informed the educational content. Codex assisted with coding and revisions, and browser previews supported review.

Creativity and design considerations

Cosmic Journey connects individual missions within one explorable experience. Planet selection, spacecraft models, surface scenes, background music, and collectible cards turn information into a journey of discovery.

Development considered scientific accuracy, readable text, consistent navigation, different screen sizes, keyboard access, reduced-motion preferences, and user control over sound. Repeated refinements improved spacing, visibility, and transitions while reducing unnecessary scrolling.
